name: apex-psi
title: APEX PSI
description: Append-only evidence receipts for AI decisions and documents. Seal a record and get a receipt, verify a hash against the public ledger, check a chain of receipts, cite a receipt, and read the Bitcoin anchoring status. A seal proves a record was made and has not changed — never that its contents are true. Verification is free and needs no account.

tools.name: seal
tools.title: Seal content
tools.description: Record content in the APEX PSI append-only ledger and return a receipt: SHA-256 hash, an Ed25519 signature over the Merkle leaf, and post-quantum ML-DSA-65 (plus LMS-W4-SHA256 when a slot is available — the receipt's own algorithm field states which). Proves that this content existed and has not changed since the timestamp. It never proves the contents are true. Free tier: 20 operations/minute, 100/day, no account needed.

content.description: The content to seal (text, up to 10000 characters)

context.description: Optional context label (e.g. document name, case ID)

predicate.description: Optional predicate describing why this is sealed

model_id.description: Optional model/agent identifier producing the seal

tools.name: verify
tools.title: Verify a receipt
tools.description: Confirm a seal's integrity against the APEX PSI append-only ledger. Accepts a receipt object (from the seal tool) or a raw SHA-256 hash. Reports whether the hash is present and anchored — integrity, not the truth of the original content.

hash.description: A SHA-256 hash to look up in the ledger (with or without 'sha256:' prefix)

receipt.description: A receipt object as returned by the seal tool

tools.name: anchor
tools.title: Bitcoin anchoring history
tools.description: Read the Bitcoin (OpenTimestamps) anchoring record for the ledger's Merkle roots. Defaults to action:'history', which is read-only and returns each anchor transaction with its txid, block height, confirmation state and how many ledger entries it covers. Pass action:'verify' with a txid to check one transaction, or action:'anchor' to explicitly request that pending roots be aggregated and submitted to the OTS calendars. Defaults to 'history' so a routine call never triggers a batch write. An anchor counts as confirmed only when a real Bitcoin block contains it.

action.description: 'history' reads the anchored transactions (default); 'verify' checks one txid; 'anchor' explicitly requests anchoring of pending roots

txid.description: Bitcoin transaction id — required only when action is 'verify'

tools.name: cite
tools.title: Generate citation
tools.description: Generate a citation for a sealed receipt in APA, BibTeX, or MLA format, citing the APEX PSI ledger entry.

receipt.description: A receipt object as returned by the seal tool

tools.name: verify_chain
tools.title: Verify a receipt chain
tools.description: Independently verify a chain of receipts against the APEX PSI ledger. Recomputes each hash's presence and integrity and reports Merkle chain continuity. Returns a verification report — a recomputation result, not an opinion or a certification.

items.description: An APEX PSI receipt object (as returned by the seal tool)

receipts.description: Array of receipt objects to verify (in order)
